title: White clubs and burials with music
summary: Allen asks whether the white carnival clubs buried members with music; Miller says they played carnival and Mardi Gras and would have used white bands.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: The buzzards ever buried with music?
You're talking about the white clubs, the buzzards.
Yeah, I know. But did they ever buried with music? No, huh?
Well, not, not, not. We didn't play no funeral. They played the carnival, Mardi Gras.
Yeah, I know. I've been to those. But I just thought maybe some of those white clubs did vary with music.
Well, if they did, they must have used white bands. They didn't have any color things. Not that I remember.
